action_summary: Closes the open thread in the certificate the question names. INSUFFICIENCY_CERTIFICATE_20261113 closed the vocabulary to 31 facts and found the obstacle 'moved from representation to combinatorics': 8,388,608 hypotheses against a learner cap of 12. Measured here on nine real actions, 36 real states and 17 real facts (486 executions): identification never enumerates that space. One success plus the two nearest refusals -- the charitable form of 'experience each action once' -- leaves 4,096-16,384 survivors that agree on nothing off-sample (6-12 of 12 held-out states undecided, set accuracy 0.000-0.333). Adding VARIED successes collapses them to 2-4 and is exact on held-out for 6 of 9 actions in at most 24 executions, because only a success in which a fact is FALSE can eliminate the superset -- so a success is the irrelevance evidence, correcting the previous round's 'a success teaches nothing'. The three residue cases are named, one of them (tar_x) for an UNSOUND column: its fact is computed by tar -tzf, which returns 0 for a gzip of garbage. Confident error: zero; the failure mode is abstention, which is the only safe one. n=17 costs 131,072 subsets and 129,140,163 conjunctions, and nothing enumerates either.

recursive_obs.expected_parent_frontier_change: A column is judged by whether it predicts the action it gates, not by whether it describes the world. Two independent readers are still worth their price, because they are free and they surface divergence -- but they do not vote. Where the action and an abstract notion of the world disagree, the plan follows the action, and the honest move is to say the world is permissive, not that the column is broken.
recursive_obs.generation_rule_changed: a fact about a precondition is a prediction of the action, and only the action can falsify it
recursive_obs.index_displacement_note: Replaces the coverage round's `stop_condition`, which demanded a soundness gate that rejects tar -tzf; measurement says tar -tzf conforms to tar -xzf on all 37 states, so such a gate would have destroyed a correct column on a presupposition.

required_capability: measuring one outcome per (action, state) on real binaries, representing survivors as bitmasks, and scoring a survivor set as a rule only where it is unanimous
stop_condition: Next: act on the corrected attribution. Since no column is unsound and every abstention left is coverage, the remaining lever is choosing which state to execute next, not which reader to trust. Measure whether a computed next-variation rule (pick the fact that splits the survivor set most, validate the state by the fact vector before executing) reaches a behaviourally unique set within the number of unpinned facts.

truth.how_the_frontier_actually_handles_this: Frontier coding agents do not arbitrate their own tools by consensus either: they run the command and read its exit status and diff, which is conformance, and the check that matters is whether the run did what was asked. Multi-reader schemes in the literature are used to surface conflicts for escalation, not to overwrite an outcome that already executed -- exactly the distinction this round measures.
truth.the_law_this_round_adds: A fact is a prediction of the action it gates, not a description of the world. Its correctness is conformance to that action's outcome, and no amount of reader agreement can override the outcome. Two free readers are worth reading because they locate the doubt; they are the wrong thing to ask for the verdict.

reading is free: every state stayed byte-identical across 34 readings and no world trial was added
tar -xzf returns zero on that state, so tar -tzf was a faithful predictor and the stdlib reader, right about the world, was wrong about the action
the conjunction only ever removes a fact, never adds one, and its cost is exactly the 0.077 it took off tar_x
